title: Sajjad main Zainab hoon meray sar pey ridaa koyi nahi, bazaar-e-jafaa
body:
Sajjad main Zainab hoon meray sar pey ridaa koyi nahi, bazaar-e-jafaa
Majmaa hai koofiyoun ka meray chalney ki jaa koyi nahi,
<<MINI>>
bazaar-e-jafaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad meray sar sey nau baar chheeni chaadar,
Balway main Nabi zaadi phirwaayi gayee dar dar,
Miljaaye ridaa mujhko aur meri dua koyi nahi
<<MINI>>
bazaar-e-jafaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad chaloon kaisey laakhoun hai tamaashaayi,
Yaad aatha hai reh reh kay Abbas mera bhaayi,
Faryaad karoon kis-say ab teray siwa koyi nahi
<<MINI>>
bazaar-e-jafaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad meray dil ko yeh dard sataatha hai,
Sar ghaazi ka naizey sey jab khaak pey aatha hai,
Sar mera khulaa dekhe gham is sey bada koyi nahi
<<MINI>>
bazaar-e-jafaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Maloom hai aada ko ghazi ki bahen hoon main,
Bey dasth hai woh ghaazi paaband-e-rasan hoon main,
Yaad aayi wafaa uski jab paas raha koyi nahi
<<MINI>>
bazaar-e-jafaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Majboor hoon beybas hoon main ro bhi nahin sakthi,
Durroun ki azeeyath sey main so bhi nahin sakthi,
Is darj-e-museebath mai hamdard mera koyi nahi
<<MINI>>
bazaar-e-jafaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad teri haalat dekhi nahin jaati hai,
Bey pardaa mujhey dekhe yeh baat rulaati hai,
Sajjad teri tarhaa kaantoun pey chalaa koyi nahi
<<MINI>>
bazaar-e-jafaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Maut aayegi zindaan mai meri baali Sakina ko,
Kya jaakay bataaoungi beemaar-e-Madina ko,
Gham dil pey uthaaney ko ab baaqi bacha koyi nahi
<<MINI>>
bazaar-e-jafaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaata hai su-ey zindaan ab kunbaa Muhammad ka,
Rassi main bandhey qaidi kaantoun say bharaa rastha,
Ummat ney sitam dhaaye qismat sey gilaa koyi nahi
<<MINI>>
bazaar-e-jafaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Bazaar-e-sitam mai tha Zainab ka ajab aalam,
Mazhar main likhoon kaisey zaalim ney kahaa jisdum,
Hai kaun tera waaris Zainab ney kaha koyi nahi
<<MINI>>
bazaar-e-jafaa
